dataset.name: Chap Malawi malaria with environmental covariates
dataset.description: Monthly district outpatient malaria case counts from Elling et al., with population, weather, vegetation, land cover, surface water, terrain and ENSO covariates.

source_citations.health: Elling et al. (2025), Malawi Malaria Incidence 2005–2023, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17161438. Related study: https://doi.org/10.1038/s43856-026-01681-9.
source_citations.chirps: Climate Hazards Center, CHIRPS version 3 (2025), https://doi.org/10.15780/G2JQ0P, accessed 2026-11-24. Funk et al. (2026), https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-026-07096-4.
source_citations.surface_water: EC JRC/Google. Pekel et al. (2016), High-resolution mapping of global surface water and its long-term changes, https://doi.org/10.1038/nature20584.

fields.name: time_period

fields.name: location
fields.description: Pinned geoBoundaries shapeID, equal to GeoJSON feature.id.

source.provider: NSO Malawi / OCHA ROSEA via geoBoundaries gbOpen

fields.name: disease_cases
fields.description: Processed malaria case count; fractional source values retained.

fields.name: population
fields.description: Overlap-weighted sum of annual people per pixel, repeated each month of that year.

fields.name: location_name
fields.description: District name, matched using the authors' ID_1 lookup.

source.provider: NSO Malawi / OCHA ROSEA via geoBoundaries gbOpen

fields.name: rainfall
fields.description: District overlap-weighted mean of monthly total_precipitation_sum multiplied by 1000. No additional days-in-month multiplier.

source.provider: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S); monthly aggregation by Google Earth Engine
source.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (2005-2023).

fields.name: mean_temperature
fields.description: District overlap-weighted mean of monthly temperature_2m minus 273.15.

source.provider: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S); monthly aggregation by Google Earth Engine
source.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (2005-2023).

fields.name: mean_relative_humidity
fields.description: Derived per grid cell from monthly T and Td (C): 100*exp(17.67*Td/(Td+243.5)-17.67*T/(T+243.5)), then overlap-weighted district mean. This is an approximation from monthly means, not a mean of hourly RH.

source.provider: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S); monthly aggregation by Google Earth Engine
source.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (2005-2023).

fields.name: seasonal_water_detected_fraction
fields.description: Fraction of the entire district grid detected as waterClass=2; unclassified pixels contribute no detections, not evidence of dry land. Read with water_classified_fraction; blank if no pixels are classified. Annual value repeated monthly. Original history through 2015; corrected v1.5 for 2016-2021; v1.5 Landsat Collection 2 for 2022-2023. Changes across versions may include processing artefacts.

source.aggregation: Earth Engine weighted mean on the original source grid; no bestEffort or coarsening

fields.name: permanent_water_detected_fraction
fields.description: Fraction of the entire district grid detected as waterClass=3; unclassified pixels contribute no detections, not evidence of dry land. Read with water_classified_fraction; blank if no pixels are classified. Annual value repeated monthly. Original history through 2015; corrected v1.5 for 2016-2021; v1.5 Landsat Collection 2 for 2022-2023. Changes across versions may include processing artefacts.

fields.name: water_classified_fraction

Original history through 2015; corrected v1.5 for 2016-2021; v1.5 Landsat Collection 2 for 2022-2023. Changes across versions may include processing artefacts.

limitations: Likoma has no case series and is excluded; missing cases have not been replaced with zeros.
Source combines surveillance series and averages overlaps. Fractional cases are intentional.
The authors adjusted 2013-2014 for underreporting using relationships with Mozambique. Treat these years separately in benchmark sensitivity analysis.
A fixed 2020 boundary geography is applied to all years; historical boundary equivalence has not been independently established.
WorldPop changes product in 2021. The discontinuity may reflect methods as well as population changes.
Population sums cover valid WorldPop cells within the supplied polygons; coastline and boundary differences may prevent conservation of national totals.
OCS weights partial grid cells by polygon overlap (exactextract). Climate means are not population weighted.
TOTALPOP and CASERATE1000 from the health source are excluded: population uses WorldPop and outcome-derived case rates would leak the target.
Annual land/water cover is repeated monthly, not observed monthly. SRTM terrain is static from 2000.
JRC seasonal/permanent fractions count detections across the entire district grid. Read water_classified_fraction alongside them; missing or masked pixels are not evidence of dry land.

Read vegetation_good_quality_fraction with NDVI and EVI, and water_classified_fraction with detected water fractions. Values below 1 indicate partial coverage. Some district estimates use very few pixels.
This is a retrospective benchmark. Same-month weather, annual maps and revised sources may be unavailable at forecast time. Validate reporting lags before forecasting.
crosswalk_method: ID_1/NAME_1 from authors' MWI_adm1.shp; exact name join to geoBoundaries. Authors' geometries are not redistributed.
